vocabulary_focus.concept: Staying Updated / Keeping Up with Technology

expressions.en: Staying updated / Keeping up with technology
expressions.cn: 紧跟科技发展 (Jǐngēn kējì fāzhǎn)
expressions.bm_formal: Kekal terkini dengan teknologi / Mengikuti perkembangan teknologi
expressions.bm_casual: Ikut perkembangan teknologi / Jangan ketinggalan teknologi

expressions.cn: 技术问题 (Jìshù wèntí) / 小故障 (Xiǎo gùzhàng)
电子商务 (Diànzǐ shāngwù) / 网上购物 (Wǎngshàng gòuwù)

work.scenario: Your company is undergoing a significant **digital transformation** to streamline operations. You need to ensure all employees are comfortable with the new **online meeting** platforms and understand the importance of **data protection** for sensitive company information.

life.scenario: Your friend just bought a new gadget and is excited about it, but you remind them to always **protect their data** when using new apps. You also discuss how important it is to **stay updated with technology** so you don't get left behind, especially for things like **online shopping**.

tech.scenario: You're trying to set up a new smart home device, but you keep encountering a **technical issue** where it **glitches** and disconnects. You decide to call customer support to troubleshoot the **problem teknikal**.
